meaning: 跨模組契約一致性審查與一次確認overlay；不是architecture批准、產品驗收或所有模組結案。17項精確修訂提案，既有驗收不重開。
authority: Latest user explicitly authorizes integration review documents only. Pending proposals diverge; no established approved-spec contradiction found in this scoped review. Accepted S1/IO unchanged.

findings.finding: H2 design_owner holds DocumentSession; newer M04 requires one common DocumentOwner. Both cannot own independent registries.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: M04 document_owner.rs owns exactly one session per project/document. M03 design_owner.rs is facade over owner token; writer transfer increments common generation, invalidates all M02/M03/M06/M07 plans tied to old generation. Content/history unchanged. No independent session initializer in facade.
findings.blocked_scope: M03 runtime owner and all consumers until joint owner amendment

findings.source_fields: M03 owner_binding.semantic_profile / M04 output_serialization / M07 capture_fingerprint
findings.finding: Old H2 untagged JSON differs shared tagged decimal-value profile; raw payload/RECOVERY-FP hashes are distinct.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 is sole proposed design semantic bytes; XML uses M04-EssXmlV1-semantic-v1. All consumers carry {profile,digest}; no cross-profile equality or baseline relabeling. M07 RECOVERY-FP wraps content semantic+asset/binding evidence and ACKs M04 original semantic only. Existing S1 hash APIs unchanged.

findings.finding: Several DTOs use u64 JSON number while UI JS cannot represent all u64 exactly; M01 has decimal-string projection.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: All UI wire revisions/generations/sequences/byte sizes beyond safe range use canonical decimal STRING 0|[1-9][0-9]* ≤u64MAX; no leading plus/zero/space/exponent. HOST parses checked u64; JS retains strings/BigInt for compare. Internal Rust u64 unchanged. Persisted machine schema numbers remain their declared integer contract, not UI parse/re-serialize.
findings.blocked_scope: All affected UI DTO transport; no domain migration

findings.finding: M04 original receipt→ACK omits catalog root promotion required by newer M05.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Save captures content/profile+exact assets→durable Save pin→file commit verified→durable formal-root transfer receipt→ACK captured revision+semantic. Transfer fail after file commit returns CommittedAckDeferred (stage=RetentionTransfer), keeps Held and original file receipt, never retries write blindly. Snapshot baseline untouched.
findings.blocked_scope: Formal save integrated with material pins

findings.finding: Pin schema Held|Transferred omits Released used by release flow; M06 adds Export purpose absent M05.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: PinState=Held|Transferred|Released. PinPurpose=Candidate|Save|Undo|Redo|Recovery|Import|Export. Only verified catalog transition updates state; Transferred/Released immutable terminal metadata. No TTL. Add matching operation results and strict decoder/negative fixtures; old product S1 untouched.
findings.blocked_scope: M05 catalog schema/decoder and M06 Export pin

findings.source_fields: M04 MaterialResolutionPort / M05 application_inputs / M07 M05_extension / M06 ports
findings.finding: M04 resolve snapshot has root_proof_id; M05 snapshot lacks matching field; later export/import methods and signatures differ.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Normalize app API: resolve(Context,Requests)->ResolutionSnapshot{context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness,assets,bindings}; pin(snapshot,purpose,operation_id)->PinReceipt; validate_pin; read_pinned_version; import_verified_versions(context,verified_bundle,purpose,operation_id); transfer(pin,RootManifest,ExternalCommitProof,operation_id); release(pin,RootBundle,operation_id). Remove root_proof_id from resolve (root observation not asset resolution proof). Versioned receipt types below authoritative proposed overlay.
findings.blocked_scope: Material import/export/resolve callers; real provider readiness

findings.finding: M04 open needs M05, M05 binding identity might depend M03 owner, M07 root completeness needs future providers. Whole-module prerequisite would deadlock.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: M03-C1/M04 codec projectors pure HOST decode+typed entity/reference inventory before runtime owner install. M05 resolves asset IDs/versions using that inventory, never calls M03 Viewer/runtime. Root-provider completeness is separate from material resolution: missing M07 root=>Unknown blocks release/cleanup, not valid pinned install. Build ports/fakes independently after adoption, then providers in order below.
findings.blocked_scope: Remove runtime construction cycle; do not weaken Unknown retention

findings.finding: Precommit failure preservation does not cover postcommit root-transfer failure. H2 still expects ordinary successful projection or rejection.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Common MutationReceipt {context,before_revision,after_revision,content_semantic,pin_id,result:Applied|NoChange|AppliedRetentionDeferred}. Once S1 commit occurred never ErrorUnchanged; retain Held/old+new union roots. M03 edit, M04 clear/undo, M06 merge/undo and M07 restore map tagged deferred result to real changed revision. No automatic rollback after publication.

findings.source_fields: M06 ProjectCopyStoragePort directory rename / IO file_commit.rs decode f[1]!=target
findings.finding: New-project copy stages M05 FileCommit catalog then renames directory; existing journal embeds canonical target path and rejects changed target. Rebinding a handle alone cannot fix journal.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Recommended A: exclusive create FINAL directory with authenticated QuarantinedCopy marker; all child/catalog commits use final stable canonical path. Project is not selectable/openable until M01 durable Ready marker commit verified. All official M01 project-open/selection paths reject quarantine (including restart). No rename of any directory containing FileCommit journals. Failed copy retains quarantined diagnostics; no recursive delete. Alternative B publish journal-free initial tree then first index commit at final path requires separate initial-publication receipt and larger schema scope; not recommended here. Never edit/move IO journal to repair.
findings.blocked_scope: New-project copy blocked REPLAN_REQUIRED until new M01/M06 publication protocol adopted

findings.finding: Self-contained verified bundle can remain forever unavailable if original project catalog/root transfer proof inaccessible after relocation/loss.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Separate LocalIntegrityReady from PublicationAcknowledged. Verified recovery index+payload+ALL asset copies permits explicit restore to authorized new destination even if SOURCE root transfer is pending; label SourceRetentionDeferred, retain original Held/Unknown, no original S1 Published/ACK. Destination import+pin+owner commit still mandatory. Missing/corrupt local bundle always blocks restore. Do not claim source retention proof merely from local readability.
findings.blocked_scope: Restore readiness UI and recovery evidence state machine

findings.finding: Holding source fences is stated but provider handles and source writer coordination are not in exact Store3trait envelope; naive final check races.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Add application SourceReadReservation trait validate()->Result<SourceSnapshotId> with lifetime guard; definition/design providers acquire held native read fences compatible with their existing exclusive write protocol BEFORE generation active writer. Approval evidence uses immutable Approved revision plus HOST source-epoch reservation; no domain OS dependency or SPEC source mutation. Add proposed Ports generation_sources.rs, adapter generation_sources.rs/tests and existing M01 dispatch/M04 document_owner provider hooks as explicit child envelope delta; if full writer coverage cannot be proven return DependencyNotReady. Store3traits remain unchanged.
findings.blocked_scope: M02 activation blocked until exact provider-fence envelope/Skeleton accepted

findings.finding: New journal-read helper is necessary but must not turn arbitrary metadata read into recovery approval or share files incompatibly.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: IO-owned crate-private read guard constructed only after OS shared lock on exact canonical FileCommit sidecar; readonly inspect under that guard validates normalized target/journal terminal state/target raw digest. Generic caller cannot forge guard or clear journal. Signature and native alias/access matrix refined in IO child packet before Skeleton; public FileCommitPort unchanged. Definition-source read coordination treated separate declared consumer, not silently widened active-only helper.
findings.blocked_scope: Only new readonly integration, accepted IO implementation not reopened

findings.finding: M04 blocks edits during formal WriteInFlight; M07 allows newer edits during immutable snapshot publication. These are different reservations, not one global saving state.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: FormalWriteReservation blocks same-owner content mutations until matching commit completion. RecoveryAttemptReservation blocks only another recovery attempt and unstable capture; after pinned immutable capture, ordinary healthy owner edits may proceed. Shared M05 catalog short transitions do not create global document mutation lock. Both reserve per-target IO as needed; no OS locks held during owner callbacks.
findings.blocked_scope: Common owner reservation model/late ACK tests

findings.source_fields: M04 lossless XML inspection/closed clear / M06 typed merge
findings.finding: Lossless XML inventory is not an adopted full entity/binding merge projector. C1 JSON cannot validate ESS XML or define every merge field.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Inspection may preserve unknown XML. Clear/merge/install require complete format-specific projector; unsupported fields hard-block affected mutation with exact paths. Freeze typed node/edge/parent/binding mapping before M06 Skeleton; no generic recursive ID rewrite, no label guessing. FreshImportedIds only on explicit confirmed preview; no identity changes hidden under codec.
findings.blocked_scope: M06 actual merge and ESS clear/import typed semantics; not plain readonly inspection

findings.source_fields: errors and result tags across packages
findings.finding: Opaque proof IDs/CommitReceipt DTO fields alone do not authenticate external commits or caller authority; identical digest string shapes have unrelated meanings.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: AuthenticatedExternalProof is server-owned immutable record with issuer module, operation kind, exact context, raw byte/receipt evidence and target identity; callers pass opaque receipt ID and service resolves in trusted registry or revalidates durable owner record. Never trust UI-copied receipt/complete bool. On restart missing owner record=>Unverified/DependencyNotReady; no fabricated ACK. Result phase codes below normalized, original module reason fields retained.
findings.blocked_scope: All cross-owner proof constructors/IPC error DTOs

findings.finding: Multiple packets name same pending owner modules and shared composition files; union is not blanket authority.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: One integration patch per owned module, explicit owner edits only; serial shared-path queue. Proposed overlay adds source-fence child and replaces M01 copy rename protocol only after Owner adopts. Rebaseline all already-dirty product paths before each Skeleton slice. Old packet hashes remain immutable; regenerated module revision must point central overlay before gate acceptance.
findings.blocked_scope: Shared-file work scheduling, all future Skeletons

findings.finding: Template source bytes/transitive lock golden and typed ESS merge mappings still incomplete; count-only BDD/recipes are not executable oracle acceptance.
findings.proposed_exact_amendment: Central adoption approves contract choices only. Mark BUILD_GOLDEN_REQUIRED / PROJECTOR_FIXTURES_REQUIRED. Exact module packet updates+independent fixture self-checks required before Skeleton/valid RED; no automatic product-ready promotion. Windows11 native remains separate gate.
findings.blocked_scope: M02 renderer/template and M06 merge readiness only; others can proceed within ready scopes

joint_contract_overlay.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

joint_contract_overlay.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
joint_contract_overlay.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
joint_contract_overlay.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
joint_contract_overlay.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
joint_contract_overlay.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
joint_contract_overlay.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

dependency_order.work: Owner adopts CX01-CX17 overlay +specific original packet decisions; mechanical module revision update before gates
Shared typed context/digest/proof/error/decimal-wire contracts; module child envelopes; C1 pure codec precision
M01 S3 native identity/auth binding; M04 pure codec/projectors; M05 native store and catalog pure contracts; M06 preflight pure slice
M04 single DocumentOwner +M03 facade; M05 durable catalog/pin providers; root registrations may report Unknown; no release
M04 formal save/root/ACK; M03 candidate install and Viewer; M06 verified archive import/export; IO source read coordination child
M07 self-contained snapshot/recovery; M06 typed merge/Undo; M01-copy quarantine/Ready publication; M02 source fencing after golden gate
Cross-owner crash/late completion/deferred proof acceptance +Windows11 native aliases/durability; module preparation/product acceptance separate

current_authorized_writes: PD-P1-ESS-DEC-01 own governance evidence note only
envelope_review.candidate_product_union: Computed per-module claims below are review data, NOT combined approval or permitted current edits.
proposed_delta_after_owner: existing M01 dispatch.rs/M04 document_owner.rs provider hooks already shared; new exact restrictions required
M06 archive_exchange ProjectCopyStoragePort replace directory rename with final-path QuarantinedCopy→Ready marker; reader/startup gates require explicit M01 child revision
envelope_review.protected: All product source/tests, accepted S1/IO sources/results, all original packet files, all unrelated cards/HTML shell/root metadata. No commit/push/release.

decision_request.adopt: CX01-CX17 exact amendments plus referenced original decisions as modified; explicit format/limit/clear/fence/no-delete choices retained, not auto-adopted
decision_request.scope: Adoption authorizes module contract/envelope revision preparation only; Skeleton still requires fully precise accepted dependencies/fixtures. Standing implementation authorization applies only after approved Skeleton+valid RED acceptance.
decision_request.non_adoption: If a correction rejected, affected child stays blocked; other independent adopted ready slices continue. No all-or-nothing global freeze.
